_source: Hu, W., Jiang, A., Chen, K., Zheng, J., Shang, W. & Cao, Z. (2025). A long-tailed distribution time-series dataset in boiler equipment. Sci Data 12:742, Table 1. Data: figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.28868849 (CC0). Coal-fired circulating-fluidised-bed boiler, Zhejiang Xin'an Chemical, 2022-03-27 → 2022-04-01, 5 s.
_units_note: Table 1 names the variables but gives no units. Units below are inferred from the tag prefix and the value ranges in the data (e.g. PT_8313x ≈ −140 → Pa, furnace draught; PTCA ≈ 9.7 → MPa; YFJ3_AI ≈ 22 → A) and are marked inferred. Bands: TE_8332A carries the paper's own normal range (530–545 °C); every other band is set from the loaded data's 1st/99th percentile by the seed script.

TE_8332A.deadband_note: ISA-18.2 rationalisation (0205): the engine's default deadband is 10 % OF THE LIMIT VALUE — 55 °C on a 550 °C limit — which flags 535 °C as 'approaching'. 1 % = 5.5 °C.
